name: lineage-era-1-tail
note: The old world, still running after the cut: one clean tail write (acct-9) and one deliberate collision (acct-1, which the new world also touched, via Close — the merge must refuse it by name). Close, not a second Open: acct-1 already exists in era 1's own data, so re-Opening it collided with the creating-command guard (a creating command refuses a second creation against the same identity) rather than exercising the fork — conflict detection is by ID (Lineage::conflict_ids INTERSECTs touched ids across the cut), not by value, so a legitimate mutation on both sides still triggers the same refusal this fixture is for.
